description: A resizable panel for patch notes: type on it and set the font, size, margins, alignment, orientation and colours
notes: click anywhere inside the panel to start editing, then click where the text should go; ESC or the Close box ends editing
the font, size, margins, alignment, orientation and the panel and text colours are all set in the Text options dialog, opened from the i mark in the title bar, from F2, or from the menu
none of those settings has a control on the panel, so no click on the module reaches help for any of them
drag the left or right edge to change the width; the drag handle appears when the pointer is over an edge
any TrueType font file can be loaded from the Font button in the Text options dialog
a Copper or Copper-mini on either side can set the panel colour or the text colour; which of the two, or neither, is chosen per side in the Text options dialog
menu: Text options... — opens the dialog holding the font, size, margins, alignment, orientation, colours and Copper targets
Bright text in a dark room — the text and the block behind it are not dimmed when the Rack room brightness is turned down
Show branding — shows or hides the #d mark on the panel
Copy info — copies the text to the clipboard
Paste info — replaces the text with whatever is on the clipboard
